notes: Ordinary npm typecheck, unit tests and production build passed in a clean temporary source copy using the existing lockfile and an external dependency tree.
The ordinary npm build and submitted export are byte-identical; no dependency or ignore-file changes were made.
Revision browser scenarios use synthetic official-API responses; the pinned design probe reached the real API without script or missing-local-resource errors.
Physical wallets, native mobile app handoffs and Coinbase passkey creation were not exercised.

limitations: Reopening and maximum-length-name regressions exercised in Chromium; WebKit exercised the existing mobile prediction and wallet-sheet scenario.
Physical wallet/app handoffs, real Coinbase passkey onboarding, screen readers, and browser-native zoom were not tested.
